spec.rawSql:
WITH target_instrument AS (
  SELECT id, name
  FROM instruments
  WHERE id IN ($instrument)
)

SELECT
  o.start_time AS time,
  o.end_time AS timeEnd,
  t.name || ' OFF' AS title,
  'TEM server offline' AS text
FROM em_off o
JOIN target_instrument t
  ON o.instrument_id = t.id

WITH params AS (
  SELECT * FROM (VALUES
    ('Autoloader', 'X', 'X.MaxControllerOut'),
    ('Autoloader', 'X', 'X.SettlingDuration'),
    ('Autoloader', 'X', 'X.MaxPositionError'),
    ('Autoloader', 'X', 'X.PositionError'),
    ('Autoloader', 'ALX', 'ALX_MoveStopped_MaxControllerOut'),
    ('Autoloader', 'ALX', 'ALX_MoveStopped_SettlingTime'),
    ('Autoloader', 'ALX', 'ALX_MoveStopped_MaxPositionError'),
    ('Autoloader', 'ALX', 'ALX_MoveStopped_PositionError')
  ) AS t(subsystem, component, param_name)
),

label_map AS (
  SELECT * FROM (VALUES
    ('X.MaxControllerOut', 'Max Controller Output'),
    ('X.SettlingDuration', 'Settling Duration'),
    ('X.MaxPositionError', 'Motion Error'),
    ('X.PositionError', 'Position Error'),
    ('ALX_MoveStopped_MaxControllerOut', 'Max Controller Output'),
    ('ALX_MoveStopped_SettlingTime', 'Settling Time'),
    ('ALX_MoveStopped_MaxPositionError', 'Motion Error'),
    ('ALX_MoveStopped_PositionError', 'Position Error')
  ) AS lm(param_name, label)
),

matching_params AS (
  SELECT p.param_id, p.param_name
  FROM parameters p
  JOIN params t
    ON p.subsystem = t.subsystem
   AND p.component = t.component
   AND p.param_name = t.param_name
  WHERE p.instrument_id = $instrument
),

raw_values AS (
  SELECT
    d.time,
    p.param_name,
    d.value_num
  FROM data d
  JOIN matching_params p ON d.param_id = p.param_id
  WHERE d.instrument_id = $instrument
    AND $__timeFilter(d.time)
),

agg_values AS (
  SELECT
    param_name,
    MIN(value_num) AS raw_min,
    MAX(value_num) AS raw_max,
    AVG(value_num) AS raw_avg,
    STDDEV(value_num) AS raw_stdev
  FROM raw_values
  GROUP BY param_name
)

SELECT
  COALESCE(lm.label, av.param_name) AS parameter,
  CASE
    WHEN av.param_name ~* 'Position' THEN
      CASE
        WHEN '$stat_type' = 'min'   THEN av.raw_min   * 1000
        WHEN '$stat_type' = 'max'   THEN av.raw_max   * 1000
        WHEN '$stat_type' = 'avg'   THEN av.raw_avg   * 1000
        WHEN '$stat_type' = 'stdev' THEN av.raw_stdev * 1000
      END
    ELSE
      CASE
        WHEN '$stat_type' = 'min'   THEN av.raw_min
        WHEN '$stat_type' = 'max'   THEN av.raw_max
        WHEN '$stat_type' = 'avg'   THEN av.raw_avg
        WHEN '$stat_type' = 'stdev' THEN av.raw_stdev
      END
  END AS value
FROM agg_values av
LEFT JOIN label_map lm ON av.param_name = lm.param_name
ORDER BY parameter;

SELECT

WITH matching_param AS (
  SELECT param_id
  FROM parameters
  WHERE instrument_id = $instrument
    AND param_name = 'PPal'
    AND subsystem = 'Krios Parameters'
    AND component = 'Vacuum'
)

SELECT
  time,
  value AS "PPal pressure"
FROM unnest(
  (
    SELECT lttb(
      time,
      value_num,
      2 * (($__to - $__from) / $__interval_ms)::int
    )
    FROM data
    WHERE instrument_id = $instrument
      AND param_id = (SELECT param_id FROM matching_param)
      AND $__timeFilter(time)
  )
)
ORDER BY time;

WITH matching_params AS (
  SELECT param_id, display_name
  FROM parameters
  WHERE instrument_id = $instrument
    AND component = 'KriosTemperatures'
    AND param_name IN ('TSample', 'Tcldwr', 'Taldwr', 'Tdocker', 'Tcassette', 'Tcartridge')
)

SELECT
  time_bucket(INTERVAL '$__interval', d.time) AS time,
  p.display_name,
  AVG(d.value_num) AS temperature
FROM data d
JOIN matching_params p
  ON d.param_id = p.param_id
WHERE d.instrument_id = $instrument
  AND $__timeFilter(d.time)
  AND d.value_num != 0
GROUP BY time, p.display_name
ORDER BY time;

SELECT
        start_time,
        end_time,
        EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM(end_time - start_time)) AS total_duration
    FROM tem_cryocycle_daily,
        state_periods(agg, 1) -- boolean = 1 where value = CryoCycle
    WHERE instrument_id = $instrument
      AND param_name = 'Autoloader'
      AND $__timeFilter(day)

WITH matching_param AS (
  SELECT param_id
  FROM parameters
  WHERE instrument_id = $instrument
    AND param_name = 'VacuumLeakFactor'
)

SELECT
  time,
  value AS "PPal pressure"
FROM unnest(
  (
    SELECT lttb(
      time,
      value_num,
      2 * (($__to - $__from) / $__interval_ms)::int
    )
    FROM data
    WHERE instrument_id = $instrument
      AND param_id = (SELECT param_id FROM matching_param)
      AND $__timeFilter(time)
  )
)
ORDER BY time;

WITH matching_param AS (
  SELECT param_id
  FROM parameters
  WHERE instrument_id = $instrument
    AND component = 'TempCtrl'
    AND param_name = 'Laldwr'
),

bucketed AS (
  SELECT
    time_bucket('30 seconds', d.time) AS bucket,
    AVG(d.value_num) AS avg_value
  FROM data d
  JOIN matching_param p ON d.param_id = p.param_id
  WHERE d.instrument_id = $instrument
    AND $__timeFilter(d.time)
  GROUP BY bucket
),

lagged AS (
  SELECT
    bucket,
    avg_value,
    LAG(avg_value, 1) OVER (ORDER BY bucket) AS val_1,
    LAG(avg_value, 2) OVER (ORDER BY bucket) AS val_2,
    LAG(avg_value, 3) OVER (ORDER BY bucket) AS val_3
  FROM bucketed
),

labeled AS (
  SELECT *,
    CASE
      WHEN avg_value > 90 AND (val_1 < 90 OR val_1 IS NULL) THEN true
      WHEN avg_value >= COALESCE(val_1, -1e9)
       AND avg_value >= COALESCE(val_2, -1e9)
       AND avg_value >= COALESCE(val_3, -1e9)
       AND avg_value > 90 THEN true
      ELSE false
    END AS is_peak
  FROM lagged
),

with_peak_groups AS (
  SELECT *,
    CASE
      WHEN is_peak AND NOT LAG(is_peak, 1, false) OVER (ORDER BY bucket) THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS new_peak_start
  FROM labeled
),

peak_groups AS (
  SELECT *,
    SUM(new_peak_start) OVER (ORDER BY bucket) AS peak_group_id
  FROM with_peak_groups
),

ranked_peaks AS (
  SELECT
    bucket AS time,
    avg_value,
    peak_group_id,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY peak_group_id ORDER BY avg_value DESC) AS val_rank
  FROM peak_groups
  WHERE is_peak
),

collapsed_peaks AS (
  SELECT
    time,
    avg_value AS value,
    'Refill' AS type
  FROM ranked_peaks
  WHERE val_rank = 1
),

raw_values AS (
  SELECT
    bucket AS time,
    avg_value AS value,
    'LN level' AS type
  FROM bucketed
)

SELECT * FROM raw_values
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM collapsed_peaks
ORDER BY time;

WITH matching_param AS (
  SELECT param_id
  FROM parameters
  WHERE instrument_id = $instrument
    AND component = 'TempCtrl'
    AND param_name = 'Laldwr'
),

bucketed AS (
  SELECT
    time_bucket('30 seconds', d.time) AS bucket,
    AVG(d.value_num) AS avg_value
  FROM data d
  JOIN matching_param p ON d.param_id = p.param_id
  WHERE d.instrument_id = $instrument
    AND $__timeFilter(d.time)
  GROUP BY bucket
),

lagged AS (
  SELECT
    bucket,
    avg_value,
    LAG(avg_value, 1) OVER (ORDER BY bucket) AS val_1,
    LAG(avg_value, 2) OVER (ORDER BY bucket) AS val_2,
    LAG(avg_value, 3) OVER (ORDER BY bucket) AS val_3
  FROM bucketed
),

labeled AS (
  SELECT *,
    CASE
      WHEN avg_value > 90 AND (val_1 < 90 OR val_1 IS NULL) THEN true
      WHEN avg_value >= COALESCE(val_1, -1e9)
       AND avg_value >= COALESCE(val_2, -1e9)
       AND avg_value >= COALESCE(val_3, -1e9)
       AND avg_value > 90 THEN true
      ELSE false
    END AS is_peak
  FROM lagged
),

with_peak_groups AS (
  SELECT *,
    CASE
      WHEN is_peak AND NOT LAG(is_peak, 1, false) OVER (ORDER BY bucket) THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS new_peak_start
  FROM labeled
),

peak_groups AS (
  SELECT *,
    SUM(new_peak_start) OVER (ORDER BY bucket) AS peak_group_id
  FROM with_peak_groups
),

ranked_peaks AS (
  SELECT
    bucket AS time,
    avg_value,
    peak_group_id,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY peak_group_id ORDER BY avg_value DESC) AS val_rank
  FROM peak_groups
  WHERE is_peak
),

collapsed_peaks AS (
  SELECT time
  FROM ranked_peaks
  WHERE val_rank = 1
),

with_deltas AS (
  SELECT
    time,
    LAG(time) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS prev_time
  FROM collapsed_peaks
),

deltas AS (
  SELECT
    EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (time - prev_time)) AS sec_between
  FROM with_deltas
  WHERE prev_time IS NOT NULL
)

SELECT AVG(sec_between) AS avg_sec_between_refills
FROM deltas;

spec.title: Temperature outliers
spec.description: Count any temperature outliers <70K or above 310K

spec.rawSql:
WITH matching_params AS (
  SELECT param_id, param_name
  FROM parameters
  WHERE instrument_id = $instrument
    AND component = 'KriosTemperatures'
    AND param_name IN ('TSample', 'Tcldwr', 'Taldwr', 'Tdocker', 'Tcassette', 'Tcartridge')
)

SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS "Count",
  MAX(d.time) AS "Last outlier"
FROM data d
JOIN matching_params p ON d.param_id = p.param_id
WHERE d.instrument_id = $instrument
  AND $__timeFilter(d.time)
  AND (d.value_num < 70 OR d.value_num > 310);

spec.title: CRT temperature recovery after cassette load (last 10 loads)
spec.description:
1) Max CRT temperature after cassette load. Time window is 3 min before cassette load counter event
2) Avg temperature increase during load. Same time window
3) Avg temperature recovery shows the difference between the CRT temperature 10 min after loading and the min temperature before loading. Values close to 0 indicate optimal recovery

spec.rawSql:
WITH 
-- Get parameter IDs
counter_param AS (
  SELECT param_id
  FROM parameters
  WHERE instrument_id = $instrument 
    AND param_name = 'LoadCassetteCounter'
),
temperature_param AS (
  SELECT param_id
  FROM parameters
  WHERE instrument_id = $instrument 
    AND param_name = 'Tcartridge'
),

-- Last timestamp per counter value → last 10 increments
load_events AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (d.value_num)
      d.value_num,
      d.time AS event_time
    FROM data d
    JOIN counter_param p ON d.param_id = p.param_id
    WHERE d.instrument_id = $instrument 
      AND $__timeFilter(d.time)
    ORDER BY d.value_num ASC, d.time DESC
  ) sub
  ORDER BY event_time DESC
  LIMIT 10
),

-- Compute pre-load temperature stats (-3 min)
event_metrics AS (
  SELECT
    l.event_time,

    -- min/max/diff of temperature in -3 min window
    (SELECT MIN(t.value_num)
     FROM data t
     JOIN temperature_param tp ON t.param_id = tp.param_id
     WHERE t.instrument_id = $instrument 
       AND t.time BETWEEN l.event_time - INTERVAL '3 minutes' AND l.event_time
    ) AS temp_min_pre,

    (SELECT MAX(t.value_num)
     FROM data t
     JOIN temperature_param tp ON t.param_id = tp.param_id
     WHERE t.instrument_id = $instrument 
       AND t.time BETWEEN l.event_time - INTERVAL '3 minutes' AND l.event_time
    ) AS temp_max_pre,

    -- temperature at +10 min
    (SELECT t.value_num
     FROM data t
     JOIN temperature_param tp ON t.param_id = tp.param_id
     WHERE t.instrument_id = $instrument 
       AND t.time >= l.event_time + INTERVAL '10 minutes'
     ORDER BY t.time
     LIMIT 1
    ) AS temp_at_plus10

  FROM load_events l
)

-- Final aggregated summary
SELECT
  MAX(temp_max_pre) AS "Max T after cassette load",
  AVG(temp_max_pre - temp_min_pre) AS "Avg T increase during load",
  AVG(temp_at_plus10 - temp_min_pre) AS "Avg T recovery 10 min after load"
FROM event_metrics

matcher.options: Avg CRT temperature increase during load
Avg temperature recovery 10 min after load

spec.title: Cassette loads since last cryo cycle

spec.rawSql:
WITH last_cryo AS (
  SELECT
    end_time
  FROM
    tem_cryocycle_daily,
    state_periods(agg, 1) -- boolean = 1 where value>0
  WHERE
    instrument_id = $instrument
    AND param_name = 'Autoloader'
  ORDER BY
    end_time DESC
  LIMIT
    1
)
SELECT
  COALESCE(SUM(lcd.daily_cassette_count), 0) AS cassette_loads_since_cryocycle
FROM
  load_counters_daily lcd
  CROSS JOIN last_cryo lc
WHERE
  lcd.day > lc.end_time
